clips.title: The story
paras: At Silverwind Refuge, the Divined Scroll can expose the mage behind Ashenvale's troubled waters. Night elves use magic from intact water elemental bracers to reveal the summoner's identity.

Mystral Lake's tainted waters trouble the Sentinels guarding Ashenvale. Sentinel Velene Starstrike gives travelers an uncharged divining scroll to trace whoever manipulates the water elementals infesting the lake. Gather intact bracers from slain elementals and use them as an arcane reagent; their latent bindings pass into the parchment. The Divined Scroll then reveals the magical signature of the rogue wizard behind the infestation.
